ai.title: How to Run NVIDIA Dory 4B with llama.cpp: Loop by Loop Guide
ai.brief: 0 4B , a small reasoning model from NVIDIA’s Nemotron Labs whose middle layers form a shared block that can be applied once, twice, three, or four times for every token. Each extra pass, or loop, spends more computation per token without adding a single parameter, so one checkpoint can run at four different compute budgets with no retraining. 7 GB GGUF, and read the architecture straight from the file to predict what each loop should cost in parameters and cache memory. We then check those predictions against the running server, measure decode speed at every loop count, test whether the cheaper last-loop cache changes the model’s predictions, and run a paired GSM8K evaluation to see how accuracy, answer length, and time per solved question move as the loops increase.

sec.title: Inside ARTEX: AI Hacking Tools, Exposed Servers and South Korean Bank Breaches
sec.brief: S. S. S. S. 3M set-top boxes into proxy servers Between late September and early October 2026, seven South Korean financial institutions had data breached through internet-facing systems. About 66,000 to 67,000 people and around 2,200 corporations were affected, and personal, employment, income and loan data was exposed. io dug into the infrastructure behind the campaign , and its findings add a lot to what CrowdStrike and Genians already published.
